benefit: Sweet alyssum (Lobularia maritima) supports hoverfly populations that suppress lettuce aphid. UC Davis trials in coastal California show aphid populations dropping 50 to 75 percent with alyssum interplanted every 5 to 8 lettuce rows.

members.title: Alyssum strip every 6 lettuce rows
members.body: Transplant alyssum 2 weeks before lettuce transplant in a single row every 5 to 8 lettuce rows. Trim back if it grows over the lettuce canopy.
